mapper.sql: id, project_name, province, city, district, industry, info_type, tenderer, win_tenderer, win_bid_price, bidding_budget, channel, publish_time, SUBSTRING_INDEX(product, ',', 5) as product, agency, detail_link, operator, operator_win_status, top_grade, service_start, service_day, service_period, win_tenderer_email, win_tenderer_manager, win_tenderer_phone, keywords

sql.if:
AND
(title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR product LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR win_tenderer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR tenderer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%'))

AND
title NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') AND project_name NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') AND product NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') AND win_tenderer NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') AND tenderer NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid
ORDER BY publish_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(IFNULL(publish_time, ''), '|', IFNULL(project_name, ''), '|', IFNULL(city, ''), '|', IFNULL(district, ''), '|', IFNULL(win_tenderer, ''))) AS distinct_total FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid
GROUP BY date_key ORDER BY date_key DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT IFNULL(province, '') AS province, IFNULL(city, '') AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid
GROUP BY province, city ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT win_tenderer AS fullname, win_tenderer AS name, COUNT(*) AS winner_count, COUNT(DISTINCT province) AS province_count, MAX(province) AS province, MAX(city) AS city, COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) AS total_revenue, MAX(publish_time) AS latest_pub_time, MAX(industry) AS top_industry FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE win_tenderer = #{companyName} GROUP BY win_tenderer
